reason: A plugin-management enhancement centered on a sidebar catalog and composer commands for reviewing, filtering, toggling, and updating self-installed plugins.

summaries.zh: 在侧边栏目录和命令输入框中按来源查看、筛选、启停并更新 DeepSeek Harness 插件。
summaries.en: Manage DeepSeek Harness plugins through a sidebar catalog and composer commands that group, filter, toggle, and update plugins.

capabilities: Lists and groups loaded plugins by official or self-installed origin
Provides sidebar catalog and composer commands for searching and filtering plugins
Enables or disables self-installed plugins by writing profile configuration and applying live loader updates
Checks the npm registry for self-installed plugin versions
Runs pnpm update for selected self-installed plugins
